reuse.why: Reuses findOrCreateBank, syncAccount and shared linking guards, but copies the existing linking workflow, transaction downloader and local unlink cleanup.

duplication.why: Fintegra adds another copy of account creation/upgrading and sync orchestration, duplicates transaction transport logic, and replacement repeats unlinkAccount's field clearing.

placement.why: Provider transport, configuration and models follow existing layers, although an assertion helper now also performs account mutations.

scope.why: Changes remain focused on linking restrictions, replacement, Fintegra integration and associated tests.

maintainability.why: Shared guards keep linking policies consistent, but copied workflows and mutation hidden behind an assertion name increase maintenance costs.

bypasses_abstraction.where: app.ts: assertBankAccountNotLinked directly duplicates unlinkAccount's local cleanup; avoiding provider removal is necessary, but the local operation should be extracted and shared.

disguised_duplication.where: sync.ts: downloadFintegraTransactions compacts the existing Enable Banking downloader; app.ts: unlinkAccount's field-clearing block is embedded inside assertBankAccountNotLinked.

abstraction_drift.where: assertBankAccountNotLinked gains replaceExistingLink and a replacement branch that mutates another account, broadening a validation helper into a state-changing operation; all six linking handlers still use the shared guards.
